text:
I have written `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152440-feature-new-text-range-styling/requirements.md` covering all required sections and incorporating the binding Gate 0 decisions:

- **In scope (1–7)** and **Out of scope (1–6)** aligned with the Gate 0 allowlist and non-goals (including no `.gitignore` modification and no changes to `excalidraw-app/collab/**` transport files).
- **Functional requirements (`FR-1`–`FR-14`)** organized by module (`packages/element`, `packages/excalidraw`, `excalidraw-app`), including:
  - `FR-1`–`FR-6`: Optional range data model on `ExcalidrawTextElement` (omitted when empty), normalization/merge/split, insert/delete offset shifting, `originalText`-to-wrapped-line mapping, per-run canvas `fillText` and background highlight fill with cache invalidation, and undo/redo history deltas.
  - `FR-7`–`FR-8`: WYSIWYG selection range styling for text colour and background highlight, with fallback to whole-element styling when no substring is selected.
  - `FR-9`: Live edit-time canvas display of coloured/highlighted runs while the editor is open, leaving the mechanism to the architect and requiring `plan.md` to justify the choice and name its jsdom test hook.
  - `FR-10`–`FR-14`: Live range shifting during typing, SVG `<tspan>` and highlight export, restore normalization, collab reconciliation, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- **Non-functional requirements (`NFR-1`–`NFR-5`)**, including existing snapshot invariance (`NFR-1`), write-contract compliance (`NFR-2`), and the fixed verification command `yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false` (`NFR-5`).
- **PII inventory**, **Role matrix**, **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1`–`AC-7`)**, and **Open questions for HITL** (none remaining).
